payload_components.notes: Complete published v2021 chunk-0 call-graph member; parsed by parse_v2021_call_graph (v2021-exact-byte-parser-v2). Upstream 0.5% trace sample. Byte-prefix or row-prefix truncation is forbidden.

Complete published v2021 chunk-0 metric member; parsed by parse_v2021_metrics (v2021-exact-byte-parser-v2). Byte-prefix or row-prefix truncation is forbidden: the dump is not time ordered, and the 2026-07-21 pilot showed a head slice silently severs ~80% of RT-MCR activity pairs.

sources.notes: CALIBRATION CORPUS v1, adopted 2026-08-09 by researcher direction, per calibration_corpus_memo.md recommendation (docs/decision_prep_20260728/calibration_corpus_memo.md, Option 1 as the source corpus with Option 3 as its deterministic working representation). Corpus = the complete published v2021 chunk-0 metric and call-graph members retained under data/payloads/ and registered above as the metrics and call_graph components; no additional Alibaba chunks are included. Excluded: chunks 1+, byte prefixes, arbitrary row prefixes, v2022, and all face-validity sources. No byte-prefix or row-prefix truncation is permitted; fits may consume only pairing-preserving derivatives whose selectors, parent component digests, counts, code version and output hashes are recorded before fitting. Registered RT-fit selector: every (service, RT metric) pair of the complete metric member that satisfies the P1 activity rule paired-same-cell-family-mcr-strictly-positive-v1 exactly (no duplicate service-instance-interval RT cell, a unique same-cell same-family MCR partner for every RT cell, documented censoring for every active zero) with at least 20 selected active cells; no outcome-dependent selection. A single payload_sha256 cannot authenticate two distinct parser inputs, so this source is component-aware and payload_sha256 stays null. Semantics: call graphs are a 0.5% sample; MCR is absolute calls/s; signed remote RT rows are paired; rt=0 is left-censored below 1 ms. Adequacy is bounded to complete v2021 chunk 0 - no whole-trace, cluster-population or between-chunk claim is authorized.
The checkout has deployment/workload material but no extracted observed curve points with page/figure/config provenance.
MCR and utilization are min-max normalized. Absolute-rate recovery is forbidden. Raw trace payload is not retained.
Example 100/1000/2000 RPS profiles are offered workloads, not observed latency curves; exact curve points are not retained.
Parser ships, but no GraphML payload is yet retained and hash-pinned; synthetic tiers, capacities and link latencies must always be stated.
